sources.summary: The Andes are often understood as a continuous mountain range, yet they encompass a wide range of climates and ecosystems. In Ecuador , Peru , Bolivia, Colombia , and Chile , páramos, dry highlands, temperate valleys, and snow-covered landscapes can exist within relatively short distances of one another. As elevation changes, so do temperature, solar radiation, humidity, wind, vegetation, and topography, producing environments that require different ways of building.
